_comment: Phase 16 (16-08): model-facing wire bodies for the two risk proposal operations on the UAT-A-like context. uatASuggestions holds ten distinct risks (eight are kept); acceptOnHigh proposes Accept on a High residual; malformed breaks the structure; rewrite returns the offshore administrator access risk with a changed impact and residual consequence.

risks.issueStatement: Unsigned payment files reconciled by hand.
risks.riskStatement: Unsigned payment files reconciled by hand could be altered before the pay run without detection
risks.riskCause: Payment files are not signed and are reconciled by hand
risks.potentialImpact: Employees or the organisation could suffer financial loss or a privacy breach.
risks.inherentRatingRationale: The exposure is present in normal operation.
risks.residualRatingRationale: Existing practices reduce but do not remove the exposure.
risks.treatmentPlan: Introduce the control described and confirm it operates before the next pay run.

risks.issueStatement: Bank detail changes requested by email.
risks.riskStatement: Bank detail changes requested by email could redirect an employee's pay to a fraudster
risks.riskCause: Bank detail changes are accepted from email requests without a call-back check
risks.potentialImpact: Employees or the organisation could suffer financial loss or a privacy breach.
risks.inherentRatingRationale: The exposure is present in normal operation.
risks.residualRatingRationale: Existing practices reduce but do not remove the exposure.
risks.treatmentPlan: Introduce the control described and confirm it operates before the next pay run.

risks.issueStatement: Bank detail changes requested by email.
risks.riskStatement: Bank detail changes requested by email could redirect an employee's pay to a fraudster
risks.riskCause: Bank detail changes are accepted from email requests without a call-back check
risks.potentialImpact: Employees or the organisation could suffer financial loss or a privacy breach.
risks.inherentRatingRationale: The exposure is present in normal operation.
risks.residualRatingRationale: Existing practices reduce but do not remove the exposure.
risks.treatmentPlan: Accept the risk because a call-back check would slow down urgent changes.

risk.issueStatement: Offshore administrators hold standing privileged access.
risk.riskStatement: Offshore support administrators with standing privileged access could read or change payroll data without detection.
risk.riskCause: Shared administrator accounts are used by the offshore support team without session recording.
risk.potentialImpact: Payroll data could be read or changed without detection, and a change to bank details could misdirect pay.
risk.inherentRatingRationale: Standing access is broad and unmonitored.
risk.residualRatingRationale: Quarterly access reviews and the bank's own checks limit what a misused account can change.
risk.treatmentPlan: Introduce session recording and just-in-time administrator access.
